text: 富途证券宣布韩股交易正式上线，中国香港地区和新加坡的合资格投资者，现可同步开启韩股交易。该服务涵盖韩国交易所（KRX）旗下KOSPI主板及KOSDAQ创业板超2700只股票，并提供韩国交易所盘前竞价时段交易。
text_en: Futubull announces the official launch of South Korean stock trading; eligible investors in Hong Kong SAR and Singapore can now trade South Korean stocks simultaneously. The service covers over 2,700 stocks on the Korea Exchange (KRX) KOSPI main board and KOSDAQ second board, and offers pre-market auction trading on the Korea Exchange.
